description: Lets the agent generate images from text prompts. Requires a provider + model config.
skill_summary: How to create images with generate_image (it delegates to the admin's image-output model even when your own model can't draw), iterate on prompts to refine a result, and — if the Model Switcher ability is enabled — optionally set_model onto a text+image-output model for an image-heavy stretch. Load when the user wants an image made.
